description: PAID over x402 inside this tool call ($0.01 USDC on Base or Arc per lookup that finds a business; no match, no charge): give a US phone number or a website and get the local business behind it: name, address, category, the best email graded A/B/C, a contact name when the email shows one, socials and buying signals. A website only matches when it carries the business's own phone number. Call once without payment to get the x402 PaymentRequired, then again with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
